result.summary: Found 1 clear visual/data issue: an invalid delivery fee is displayed in the restaurant carousel.

issues.description: The “Smash Bros Burgers” card displays “€NaN delivery,” exposing an invalid numeric value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Validate and format the delivery-fee value before rendering. If the fee is unavailable, show a fallback such as “Delivery fee unavailable” or omit the fee.
